name: github-talent-mcp
description: Search, score, and rank GitHub developers for technical recruiting. Exposes 9 tools: plan_search, search_developers, get_developer_profile, rank_candidates, score_against_jd, compare_candidates, bulk_score, generate_outreach, get_repo_contributors.

GITHUB_TOKEN.title: GitHub Personal Access Token
GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Fine-grained token with read:user and public_repo scopes. Create at github.com/settings/tokens. Required for API rate limits (5,000/hr vs 60/hr unauthenticated).
